description: Refresh up to 100 selected listings in one batch instead of opening each listing. The catalog stores the values seen at the last real change of a listing; counters and package versions change over time. After a search, use this batch or MCP listing_updates before comparing versions. These values may be cached for up to 15 minutes; `generated_at` is the slice generation date, not a check date for each record. Listings without a record are unknown and simply absent. `GET /api/listings/:id` already applies these values on top of the record.
name: listing_updates
title: Listing updates
